frequency_question: How often do successfully negotiated interstate water framework renewals result in a formal signed treaty meeting documentation criteria within the deadline window?
membership_rule: Members are major transboundary river basin treaty renewals where prior frameworks expired or approached expiration. Excluded are informal management committees without formal treaty status.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and adjustments
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase II Agreement
Senegal River Basin Development Organization charter updates

provenance_note: claimed 4 hits but 5 of 5 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases; rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major historical precedents; broader global set estimated at ~20 with similar high conversion once political agreement is reached.
known_gaps: Excludes minor tributary local arrangements not tracked by international water law databases.
skeleton: Total historical interstate water treaty renewals matching formal criteria divided by total attempted renewals reaching final text agreement stage
multiplier: 4 hits out of 5 documented major basin negotiations reaching final ministerial agreement
validity_reason: Bilateral treaty drafting standards and diplomatic reporting conventions change slowly over decades.
